title: Softly and Tenderly Jesus Is Calling
description: Softly and Tenderly Jesus Is Calling in Tonic Solfa to THOMPSON: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Will L. Thompson wrote both the words and the tune; the song was published in 1880.
underlay: Soft-ly and ten-der-ly Je-sus is call-ing, Call-ing for you and for me; See, on the por-tals He’s wait-ing and watch-ing, Watch-ing for you and for me. Come home_, come home_, You who are wea-ry, come home__; Ear-nest-ly, ten-der-ly, Je-sus is call-ing, Call-ing, O sin-ner, come home!

lines: Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me;
See, on the portals He’s waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!
Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?
Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing,
Passing from you and from me;
Shadows are gathering, deathbeds are coming,
Coming for you and for me.
Oh, for the wonderful love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned, He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.
